he: יֹ֭שֵׁב בְּסֵ֣תֶר עֶלְי֑וֹן בְּצֵ֥ל שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְלוֹנָֽן׃
en: He that dwells in the secret place of the Most High; in the shadow of Shakkai he shall lodge.

he: אֹמַ֗ר לַ֭יהֹוָה מַחְסִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֑י אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֶבְטַח־בּֽוֹ׃
en: I say to Havayah: my refuge and my fortress; my God, in Him I trust.

he: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַ֭צִּילְךָ מִפַּ֥ח יָק֗וּשׁ מִדֶּ֥בֶר הַוּֽוֹת׃
en: For He shall deliver you from the snare of the trapper, from the destroying pestilence.

he: בְּאֶבְרָת֨וֹ ׀ יָ֣סֶךְ לָ֭ךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָ֣יו תֶּחְסֶ֑ה צִנָּ֖ה וְסֹחֵרָ֣ה אֲמִתּֽוֹ׃
en: With His pinion He shall cover you, and under His wings you shall take refuge; His truth is a shield and buckler.

he: לֹֽא־תִ֭ירָא מִפַּ֣חַד לָ֑יְלָה מֵ֝חֵ֗ץ יָע֥וּף יוֹמָֽם׃
en: You shall not fear for the terror of the night; for the arrow that flies by day.

he: מִ֭דֶּבֶר בָּאֹ֣פֶל יַהֲלֹ֑ךְ מִ֝קֶּ֗טֶב יָשׁ֥וּד צׇהֳרָֽיִם׃
en: For the pestilence that walks in darkness; for the destruction that wastes at noon.

he: יִפֹּ֤ל מִצִּדְּךָ֨ ׀ אֶ֗לֶף וּרְבָבָ֥ה מִימִינֶ֑ךָ אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א יִגָּֽשׁ׃
en: A thousand shall fall at your side, and a myriad at your right hand; to you it shall not approach.

he: רַ֭ק בְּעֵינֶ֣יךָ תַבִּ֑יט וְשִׁלֻּמַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃
en: Only with your eyes you shall look, and you shall see the retribution of the wicked.

he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן שַׂ֣מְתָּ מְעוֹנֶֽךָ׃
en: For You, Havayah, are my refuge; the Most High you have made your dwelling.

he: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּ֣ה אֵלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝נֶ֗גַע לֹא־יִקְרַ֥ב בְּאׇהֳלֶֽךָ׃
en: No evil shall befall you, and no plague shall come near your tent.
For His angels He shall command for you, to keep you in all your ways.
Upon hands they shall bear you, lest you strike against the stone your foot.

he: עַל־שַׁ֣חַל וָפֶ֣תֶן תִּדְרֹ֑ךְ תִּרְמֹ֖ס כְּפִ֣יר וְתַנִּֽין׃
en: Upon the lion and the adder you shall tread; you shall trample the young lion and the serpent.

he: כִּ֤י בִ֣י חָ֭שַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ אֲ֝שַׂגְּבֵ֗הוּ כִּֽי־יָדַ֥ע שְׁמִֽי׃
en: For in Me he desired, and I shall deliver him; I shall set him on high, for he knew My Name.

he: יִקְרָאֵ֨נִי ׀ וְֽאֶעֱנֵ֗הוּ עִמּֽוֹ־אָנֹכִ֥י בְצָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלְּצֵ֗הוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵֽהוּ׃
en: He shall call Me, and I shall answer him; with him I am in distress; I shall rescue him and I shall honor him.
With length of days I shall satisfy him, and I shall show him in My salvation.
